description:
## Dual VoT Patches 1.38.0-dualvot.8.3

Stable update based on Morphe Patches 1.38.0.

### Yandex timing fixes

- Checks translation readiness at most every 15 seconds without replacing the displayed server ETA.
- Keeps an expired countdown expired instead of restarting it at three or five seconds.
- Prevents the progress ring from refilling when Yandex returns a later estimate.
- Synchronizes whole-minute rounding on the player button and long-press status sheet.
- Delivers audio upload progress updates on the Android UI thread.

### Validation

- Yandex timing unit tests passed.
- Android patch bundle compiled successfully.
- Both translation patches and required Dual VoT integration sources were verified.

Runtime behavior should still be confirmed on a device; regressions that cannot be detected by compilation should be reported in this repository.
